title: Ladies Day 2026
subtitle: A season of Southwest Division Ladies Days, club by club, through 2026.

sections.heading: April 8, 2026 — Newport Harbor LBC
body: Newport Harbor LBC hosted our first Ladies Day of 2026. Hospitality was amazing. A huge thank you to Sally Cadwallader for doing a great job organizing all our hospitality. Breakfast was delicious with Eleanor Reafsnyder’s famous deviled eggs, along with bagels, cream cheese and yummy desserts. Lunch was also amazing with plenty of salads including Desiree Hamiltons’ mango salad which was a big hit. I definitely must mention that the tables were so festive, thanks to Wendy Valdes and Angela Laws setting everything up.

These ladies attended Ladies Day for the first time ever and we hope to continue seeing them: Rochelle Waskin, Beth Do and Elia Wang from Pasadena LBC and Julie Akau from Santa Ana. We had 48 Ladies from 9 clubs attending this time.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning, 12 ends were played, and the winners were:
1st Place: Cindy Jones, Chris Adams, Shelley Cohen
2nd Place: Charlyn Moltane, Karen Sando, Rochelle Waskin
3rd Place: Trish Soto, Jana Edler, Molly Smulian
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Cindy Jones, Eleanor Reafsnyder, Vicki Wong
2nd Place: Trish Soto, Catherine Early, Molly Smulian
3rd Place: Joanne Steckler, Karen Sando, Rochelle Waskin
Congratulations to all the winners.
Next month, Long Beach LBC will be hosting Ladies Day on Wednesday, May 13th. Our motto is the more the merrier, so let’s keep sounding the word.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: May 13, 2026 — Long Beach LBC
body: Long Beach LBC hosted our Ladies Day and their hospitality was terrific. They took care of all the ladies for lunch with several great salads and plenty of desserts.

We welcomed ladies from several clubs joining us for the first time. The Groves LBC: Marina Pavlovich; Hermosa Beach LBC: Linda Purkiss, Denise Loversky and Denise Schneider; Long Beach LBC: Elen Castleberry and Joyce Zoubel; Laguna Woods LBC: Row Gallo. We had 43 Ladies from 9 clubs attending this time. Everyone, keep promoting Ladies Day – the more the merrier.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning 12 ends were played and the winners were:
1st Place: Tory Ruppert, Elen Castleberry, Molly Smulian
2nd Place: Julie Kimura, Deborah Long, Lisa Morrone
3rd Place: Patty Doidge, Connie Delgado, Barbara Hardesty
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Claudia Sego, Eleanor Reafsnyder, Vicki Wong
2nd Place: Doreen Hall, Susie Rausavljevich, Denise Loversky
3rd Place: Aileen Broccardo, Catherine Early, Marina Pavlovich
Congratulations to all the winners.

Wednesday, June 10th Hermosa Beach will be hosting our next Ladies Day. They have graciously offered to serve lunch for everyone. Send in your list of those attending early so the host club can prepare for our lunch.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: June 10, 2026 — Hermosa Beach LBC
body: Hermosa Beach LBC hosted our Ladies Day, and their hospitality was amazing. They served a wonderful breakfast, which included my favorite, lox and bagels, and even had 3 different cream cheeses. Someone also made a great quiche. They provided a full lunch for everyone, which was greatly appreciated. Thank you, Hermosa Beach.

Joining us for the first time were: Kathy Ladd, Karen Esparza, Judy Brothers and Sylvia Perez from Friendly Valley LBC. Also, Grace McDougal from The Groves LBC. We had 43 Ladies from 10 clubs attending this time. Thank you all for attending and we hope to see you at more Ladies Days in the future.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning, 12 ends were played, and the winners were:
1st Place: Aileen Broccardo, Karen Shorr, Cathy Ostrom
2nd Place: Sandra Mironesco, Elen Castleberry, Bunny Halter
3rd Place: Diana Wenzel, Kathy Ladd, Marina Pavlovich
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Esther Lee, Barbara Hardesty
2nd Place: Aileen Broccardo, Karen Esparza, Marina Pavlovich
3rd Place: Patty Doidge, Judy Brothers, Bunny Halter
Congratulations to all the winners.
Wednesday, July 8 Newport Harbor LBC will be hosting our next Ladies Day. Start gathering your list of those attending.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: July 8, 2026 — Newport Harbor LBC
body: Newport Beach LBC hosted our Ladies Day, and everyone enjoyed their selection of breakfast and lunch items. A special thanks to Sally Cadwallader, who makes sure that everything is ready to be served at the right time.

We had 48 Ladies from 10 clubs attending this time. Ladies attending for the first time were: Marti Hall from the Groves, Pat McClure and Julie Hermann from Newport Beach. Thank you all for attending, and we hope to see you at more Ladies Days in the future.
A special thanks to Norma Goodhart, who filled in for Shelley and helped Diana Wenzel make sure Ladies Day ran smoothly.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning, 12 ends were played, and the winners were:
1st Place: Norma Goodhart, Deborah Long, Marina Pavlovich, Julie Hermann
2nd Place: Susie Houston, Diane Prior, Barbara Hardesty
3rd Place: Heather Stewart, Eleanor Reafsnyder, Sheila Beingessner, Grace McDougal
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Norma Goodhart, Desiree Hamilton
2nd Place: Doreen Hall, Janell Williams, Denise Schneider
3rd Place: Deborah Long, Angela Laws, Barbara Hardesty
Congratulations to all the winners.
Wednesday, August 12th, Laguna Beach LBC will be hosting our next Ladies Day. Start gathering your list of those attending.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

sections.heading: August 12, 2026 — Laguna Beach LBC
body: Laguna Beach LBC hosted our Ladies Day, and their hospitality was amazing. It’s always a treat to walk into their clubhouse and see such a nice arrangement of food to enjoy.

We had 53 Ladies from 10 clubs attending this time. (Casta del Sol, The Groves, Holmby Park, Laguna Woods, Laguna Beach, Long Beach, Newport Harbor Oaks North, Santa Ana and a visitor from Berkeley) Thanks to all the Delegates and members who promote Ladies Day; we are very successful. It is wonderful to welcome these Ladies attending for the first time: From Oaks North, Angie Gonzales, Hui Wang and Stephanie Thomas (thanks for driving the distance). Laguna Beach, Caroline Hagemeier; Newport Harbor, Barbara Marr, and Beverly McCabe, and a visitor from Berkeley, Janine Maddock.
And now for our results of this day’s bowling.
In the morning, 12 ends were played, and the winners were:
1st Place: Joan Narmontas, Terri Bisch, Marina Pavlovich
2nd Place: Kelly Lacey, Madeline Wilson, Jenn Selcho
3rd Place: Heather Stewart, Myra Farrell, Marti Hall
The afternoon game of 10 ends was won by:
1st Place: Janine Maddock, Janelle Williams, Linda Bator
2nd Place: Sandra Mironesco, Caroline Hagemeier, Terri Bisch
3rd Place: Heather Stewart, Madeline Wilson, Marti Hall
Congratulations to all the winners.

Wednesday, September 9th, Santa Ana LBC will be hosting our next Ladies Day. Start gathering your list of those attending. I will be sending out driving directions – it is a little tricky to get there. Don’t just Google their address. Also be aware that there are steps to climb, but they will have help for those who need it.
Shelley Cohen and Diana Wenzel, Ladies Day Coordinators

migrationNotes: Migrated from the Squarespace blog collection /ladies-day-2026, which held five posts — one per Ladies Day. Each post became a prose section (its date and venue as the heading) followed by its gallery.

All five post URL slugs are the Squarespace placeholder 'Blog Post Title One' with suffixes. The post titles themselves were real ('April 8 Newport Harbor', 'May 13, Long Beach Lawn Bowling Club', and so on) but carried no year, so the year has been added to each heading from the posts' own content.
Each post opened with a line repeating its own date and venue ('May 13, 2026 - Ladies Day at Long Beach LBC'). That line has been dropped from the body because it now serves as the section heading.

The April post is titled 'April 8 Newport Harbor' but its opening line reads 'Apr 9, 2026'. The heading follows the title — April 8, 2026, which was a Wednesday, the usual Ladies Day — and the discrepancy is recorded here rather than resolved.
The July 8 post has no photographs of the day, only the three winners' graphics.
A few images repeat within the May and June galleries (the same photograph appears in two gallery blocks on the source post); they have been carried across as they appear.
Squarespace's alt text on these images was just the file name, so all alt text here was written fresh from the pictures.
